services.description: List of Cyrus replication services to start. Each object defines the service name, type (e.g. 'unix' or 'cmd'), command to run, and optional arguments.

name.description: Service name as referenced in Cyrus startup scripts (e.g., 'replica', 'replicator-manager')

type.description: Service type. 'cmd' means run as a standalone process.

command.description: Executable command to launch the service (e.g. 'cyrus replicator')

args.description: Command-line arguments to pass (e.g. config file path)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for secure replication connections between master and replica servers.

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle used to verify replica/master certificates.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate for this replica server (used when acting as TLS client or server).

tls_key_file.description: Path to private key corresponding to tls_cert_file.

debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debugging output in logs for troubleshooting replication issues.
